def policy(board):
    import time
    start_time = time.time()
    time_limit = 0.9

    # Copy board
    board = [row[:] for row in board]

    # immediate win detection
    for col in get_possible_moves(board):
        row = get_drop_row(board, col)
        board[row][col] = 1
        if is_win(board, 1):
            # revert and return
            board[row][col] = 0
            return col
        board[row][col] = 0

    # immediate block detection (if opponent can win next move)
    for col in get_possible_moves(board):
        row = get_drop_row(board, col)
        board[row][col] = -1
        if is_win(board, -1):
            board[row][col] = 0
            return col
        board[row][col] = 0

    # iterative deepening
    best_move = None
    best_score = -INF
    depth = 1
    while True:
        moves = get_possible_moves(board)
        if not moves:
            break
        # order moves
        ordered_moves = [c for c in [3,2,4,1,5,0,6] if c in moves]

        time_exceeded = [False]
        best_score_depth = -INF
        best_move_depth = None
        for col in ordered_moves:
            row = get_drop_row(board, col)
            board[row][col] = 1
            score = minimax(board, depth-1, -INF, INF, False, start_time, time_limit, time_exceeded)
            board[row][col] = 0
            if time_exceeded[0]:
                # timed out
                break
            if score > best_score_depth:
                best_score_depth = score
                best_move_depth = col
        if time_exceeded[0]:
            # we didn't finish this depth; break out of deepening
            break
        # update best_move to this depth's result
        best_move = best_move_depth
        best_score = best_score_depth
        depth += 1
        if depth > 10:  # safety limit
            break

    if best_move is None:
        # fallback: pick first legal column
        for col in [3,0,1,2,4,5,6]:
            if board[0][col] == 0:
                return col
    return best_move
